name: Shenzhen Longsys Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Longsys Electronics Co., Ltd. engages in the research, design, packaging, testing, production, and sales of semiconductor memory application products. The company provides products, such as embedded storage; solid-state drives; mobile storage products, including USB flash drives, memory cards, and portable SSDs; and memory modules; and services, including firmware algorithm development, memory chip design, testing, and packaging design. It also offers automotive, industrial, enterprise, and small-capacity storage solutions.
